full_prompt_en: A square action painting shows a small group of mounted riders coming forward over a grassy ridge beneath a strong turquoise blue sky. The sky fills most of the upper half, with a low bank of pale cloud behind the riders on the right. Short sunlit grass and gray stones occupy the sloping foreground, leaving the animals and figures sharply silhouetted against the open color. At the center, a white horse lifts its front legs as it moves toward the viewer. The rider above it wears a large fan-shaped feathered headdress with white tips, dark feather ends and a red band near the face. Warm tan and red garments cross the chest, and one hand holds a long narrow staff or weapon angled toward the upper right. On each side, riders on darker brown horses follow slightly behind. Their feathered headwear and long angled poles repeat the central upward rhythm at smaller scales. Farther to the left, additional riders and horse heads overlap in a rougher, darker cluster, partly hidden by the crest of the hill. The animals have taut necks and raised legs, but their movement is conveyed as much by broken brown and cream paint strokes as by precise anatomy. Warm light comes from the upper left and front, catching the white horse, pale feather tips, tan clothing and the tops of the rocks. Deep reddish brown shadows define the flanking horses and the group behind, while the sky stays clear and cool. Loose, energetic brushwork scatters around manes, clothing and grass, contrasting with the smoother blue backdrop. No lettering or decorative border interrupts the scene. The overall composition pushes a bright central mount toward the viewer, using repeated feather fans and slanting poles to turn a compact group into a broad forward surge.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动作绘画描绘一小群骑手在强烈绿松石蓝天空下越过草坡向前而来。天空占上半幅大部分，右侧骑手后方有低低浅云。短促受光草茎和灰石填满倾斜前景，使人马在开阔色域前形成清楚剪影。中央一匹白马抬起前腿，向观者奔来。其骑手戴着扇形大羽饰头冠，羽尖白、末端深色，脸附近有一圈红带。暖棕褐与红色衣物横过胸前，一只手举着指向右上方的细长杆或武器。两侧骑手骑着较深褐的马，稍稍落后。他们的羽饰头冠和斜长杆以较小尺度重复中央向上节奏。更靠左处，还有骑手与马头在较粗暗的团块里交叠，部分被山脊遮住。马的颈部绷紧、腿部抬起，但运动感同样来自断续棕色与奶油色笔触，并非全靠精准解剖。暖光从左上与正前方来，照亮白马、浅羽尖、棕褐衣物和岩石顶面。深红褐阴影定义两侧马匹与后方人群，天空则保持清冷。松散而有劲的笔触散在鬃毛、衣服和草地周围，对照更平滑的蓝色背景。没有文字或装饰边框打断场景。整体构图把明亮的中央坐骑推向观者，以重复羽扇和斜杆让紧凑人群成为宽阔前冲之势。
style_prompt_en: The image has an energetic oil-painted finish, pairing a broad smooth cool field with rough, broken marks around crowded focal forms. Clear turquoise blue occupies large open space, while warm tan, rust brown, cream and small red accents gather in a compact lower cluster. One bright central mass pushes forward against darker flanking masses. Repeated fanlike and diagonal strokes expand the movement upward and outward, and looser peripheral marks keep the edge of the cluster active. Sunlight from an upper frontal side gives pale forms strong highlights and lets dark warm shadows separate overlapping volumes. Fine details are selective; much of the impression comes from value contrast, brush direction and changing scale. The overall effect is vigorous and spacious, with an open cool background heightening the force of the dense warm center.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有充满劲道的油画完成面，宽大平滑的冷色域与拥挤焦点形体周围粗糙断笔痕并置。清楚的绿松石蓝占据开敞大面积，暖棕褐、锈褐、奶油白和少量红色强调聚成下方紧凑群组。一块明亮中央大形体向前顶出，对照两侧更暗团块。重复扇形与斜向笔触把运动向上向外扩展，外围更松散的痕迹使群组边缘活跃。来自上方偏正面的日光给浅色形体强高光，深暖影把交叠体积分开。细节有选择地保留；整体印象更多来自明暗反差、笔触方向与尺度变化。整体效果有力而开阔，开敞冷色背景加强浓密暖色中心的冲劲。
theme_en: Mounted riders in feathered headdresses crossing a grassy ridge under a blue sky
theme_zh: 戴羽饰头冠的骑手穿过蓝天下的草坡
name: Frank McCarthy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
